10032.source: Official Flash bg_mc and animator_mc first frames; the original platform, energy surface and machine vectors are restored in source placement and depth order.

10032.restorationScope: Static animator frame 1 only; control_mc, top_mc, scripted events and subsequent animation frames are excluded.

staticOverlay.matrixUnits: Linear coefficients are unitless; source translation values are SWF twips (20 per pixel).
staticOverlay.filterHandling: Sprite 8 has a zero-blur, zero-strength GlowFilter. Sprite 11 has zero blur/strength in its glow and blur filters and is fully transparent in frame 1. These filters are visually inert.
staticOverlay.scope: Original static decoration only; control_mc, top_mc and ActionScript are excluded.

attribution: Original official Seer artwork. No replacement art was generated or claimed as locally authored.
assetScope: Static background layers only; current official resource versions, including later official redesigns. Dynamic foregrounds, scripted events and historical 2009 fidelity are not established by these files.

movementSource.verifiedSemantics: MapModel._gridSize = 10; setRoad records only cells equal to 1 as allowed positions; AStar traverses Boolean(data[x][y]). Coordinates use x-major arrays.
